selected_evidence.requirement: Non-interactive RSA SSH access for opsadmin
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the 3072-bit RSA key, secure ownership/modes, successful public-key authentication as opsadmin, and successful post-reboot access.

selected_evidence.requirement: Pinned server host key and prompt-free rejection of unexpected keys
selected_evidence.summary: Shows effective batch/strict host-key settings and mismatch rejection with exit status 255 before and after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep installed OS release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 match before and after the work.

Captures the healthy pre-restart state, reboot acknowledgement, boot ID change from e65e6bcf-e09d-42b7-8317-cb6310086cb7 to 8873e738-e429-4cab-b6c9-603eaf54f000, and recovered SSH service, unchanged configuration checksums, permissions, key fingerprint, and live login.
